description: This script profiles peak Resident Set Size (RSS) memory usage for extension entrypoints in a build system. It loads extension modules, runs them in isolated child processes, and collects memory metrics, producing reports and summaries. It is used for monitoring memory characteristics of extensions after build.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the profiling script.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string as a positive integer, throws error if invalid.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into options for profiling.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts the maximum RSS value in MB from stderr output.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Creates a concise preview of stderr output.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a child process with specified body and environment, returns resource usage details.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Creates a script body that imports specified files and exits.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Finds extension entry points in the build directory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating the profiling process.
